summary: The complete trajectory law, cumulative discounted visits and biased payoffs are actual finite interpreters. Genuine derivatives at actual prefix states are independently identified with those visits, rather than assumed. One verified source tie mismatch was repaired by a separately checked ordered finite-pool adapter; the generic binary primitive retains its own right-tie semantics.
source: arxive/playingTheNetworkBackward/main.tex:1460–1488 complete p/q/k derivative and tie formula

findings.severity: high for direct source-tie promotion; no false generic theorem
findings.classification: verified counterexample to proposed model correspondence
findings.evidence: At split operands (2,1) and (1,0), both represented values equal positive one. Generic maximum(input0,input1) selects input1 and pair(1,0); source min-index convention selects input0 and pair(2,1). Kernel entries are respectively (0,1) versus (1,0). Independent Boundary.lean proves this and excludes classical regularity at the tie.
findings.minimal_repair: Encode source finite pools with earlier operands on the right branches; prove least maximizing index, actual selected pair/kernel and unique-winner regularity, and use that adapter in source links.

resolution.verdict: The new orderedInputPool implements the paper convention at every nonempty finite arity, including unequal split pairs tied in represented value. The old generic primitive is not renamed. Source-facing promotion must include this adapter.

model_correspondence.verdict: genuine calculus, no assumed Jacobian recurrence
model_correspondence.evidence: expressionKernel is computed from syntax and actual represented scores; local max derivatives follow eventual winner stability from score continuity. Actual chain rules through snoc and composition yield stoppingCircuit_hasFDerivAt for all recorded shared values. CircuitRegular is a concrete strict-cell property, checking only the winning subtree inside each max. Product syntax is explicitly excluded by Additive and cannot leak through zero placeholder rows.

model_correspondence.verdict: actual path law, nonvacuous at empty fan-in
model_correspondence.evidence: A path either bypasses later recorded states, follows a signed predecessor, or ends at one cemetery; no fictitious post-cemetery tails are introduced. Transition weights are actual nonnegative edge coefficients divided by local magnitude sum. A zero sum leads to cemetery probability one; nonnegativity proves all weights vanish there. Sign changes are XOR. Normalization is proved separately from actual kernel recovery.

model_correspondence.topic: Full visits and arbitrary intermediate cuts
model_correspondence.evidence: visitWeight sums the current state indicator and discounted later visits, while bypasses add no visit. fullOccupation averages this actual quantity under the original graph law. Strictly decreasing node indices prove the cut bridge to suffix terminal occupation. exists_graph_cut constructs a prefix ending at every internal recorded target; original input visits are separately identified with endpoint occupation. Neither cut equality nor derivative identity is a hypothesis.

model_correspondence.topic: Actual prefix states and full sign identities
model_correspondence.verdict: complete p/q/k formula and ordinary gradient
model_correspondence.evidence: Grafting literally reuses the same earlier recorded graph; both original and stopping evaluators compose. The suffix derivative is evaluated at the actual stopping prefix pair. Ordinary derivatives use an affine lift keeping the negative prefix stream fixed, hence are evaluated at actual pre.eval(xP-xN), without assuming a zero negative stream. All eight p/q/k parity cases and the arbitrary starting-sign scalar formula are included.

expressionOffset recursively computes the selected affine bias independently of the derivative. pathPayoff accumulates immediate bias rewards and discounted continuation/input rewards; its expectation is proved to equal actual stopping streams. Biases do not enter weight normalization. A dimension-zero negative constant graph terminates at cemetery yet pays its negative-stream magnitude five.

Affine rows have canonical signs, discount sum|w|, and actual canonical bias. Addition has discount two with fair-branch push-forward, including duplicate operands. ReLU stops at zero. Ordered finite pools choose the least maximizing operand position and the actual shared predecessor row; sorted enumeration additionally gives least graph-node index. A unique maximum suffices for concrete regularity despite tied losing tails.

independent_dag_experiment.scope: Finite exact checks supplement universal Lean proofs. Probabilities and full paths are independently enumerated; actual forward finite differences check strict-cell derivatives. Generic right-tie semantic model tested; ordered source pool adapter separately required.

independent_ordered_pool_experiment.scope: Source min-operand-index tie choice equals actual recursively compiled right-tie syntax; unique winners remain regular despite tied losing tails. Unsorted enumeration deliberately means operand position, not node index.

scope_limits: The source-directed model is additive shared DAG syntax: arbitrary signed affine/addition/scaling/maxima/ReLU. Products are excluded.
The path law follows the fixed selected stopping policy. This batch does not independently prove an extensive-form equilibrium theorem over alternative policies.

Full visits count recorded Circuit nodes. Compound expression interiors are collapsed into their selected local predecessor row; source structural states must be recorded when visits to those states are desired.

Actual classical derivatives require concrete regular cells. At ties only selected operators are identified, and individual stopping streams may be discontinuous. No merely-head-differentiability or almost-everywhere extension is asserted.
Generic binary maxima retain right ties. Source finite pools must use orderedInputPool with the intended operand enumeration; least graph index additionally needs sorted enumeration.
